title: Hall family: Edward, Clarence, Herbert, and uncle T-Man
summary: Edward Hall is one of the brothers; Clarence and Herbert started on banjo, and their uncle T-Man played guitar in the band.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well that bass player, his name is Edward Hall? Yeah, Edward Hall. Is he related to Clarence and...
Which one, the one that, this one here, that's one of the brothers. That's one of the brothers.
Yeah. One of the brothers. What did you say Clarence's original instrument was to? Which one, Clarence?
Clarence. Clarence started on the banjo.
And Herbert started on the banjo too.
See when Clarence left, we took Herbert in his place. And he just picked it up and in a little while he could read faster than the uncles.
Edmund told me he had an uncle who played guitar, banjo or something.
Yeah, he had an uncle who played a guitar.
What was his name? I think his name was Edmund.
I think his name was Edmund. He had some sort of nickname. T-Man, we called him. The nickname was T-Man.
Oh. T-Man? Like you said, Little Man.
Little Man, T-Man. Yeah, in French, you know.
That reminds me of something. He played guitar with me too. Oh yeah?

Which band was that? That was right after Dejan, it was Lawrence and Dewey. His brother was playing trombone. I can't recall all of the fellas that played with me. Every once in a while I think of one of them that used to play with me.
